# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc14

This candidate keeps essential progress context visible while polishing the P5R calendar marker.

- Pins the achievement counter and due/upcoming summary to the top of the Achievements tab while its list scrolls.
- Applies the sticky summary to both rule-based achievement catalogs and legacy media-backed catalogs.
- Enlarges the P5R Calendar **TODAY** lettering from 23sp to 30sp and reduces its inner padding so the label nearly fills the red marker.
- Adds a regression check for the Calendar marker proportions.
